pageSections.title: Analyzing Brain Atrophy in Dementia Using Computer Vision
pageSections.description: Neerav Chaudhary and Sourabh Singh Verma · 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (ICRITO).

pageSections.title: Longitudinal MRI analysis and quantitative atrophy measurement
pageSections.description: The paper studies structural brain change visible across MRI scans collected over time.
pageSections.markdown:
The study applies computer-vision methods to prepare longitudinal MRI images, extract structural information, and quantify change associated with brain atrophy. Its contribution is an image-analysis workflow and the measurements reported in the paper.

The later four-class CNN study has a different repository, dataset organization, prediction task, and evaluation record. Its evidence appears on a separate case-study page.
